svg.title: rc-worm gait: the angle each servo is asked to hold, tick by tick
svg.text: The gait: a travelling wave of servo targets
WormLib::Gait ticked at 32 Hz for the worm's 7 joints: each row is one joint's servo target within the ±0.9 rad swing bound.
a crest of the straight run: each joint meets it a quarter cycle after the one before - the wave travels tailward
turning left adds the same bend to every joint; the swing bound clips the sum into flat tops
